name: @statens-pensjonskasse/skatt-inntekt-api
description: Npm package holds OpenAPI specification for Skatteetatens Inntekt API
_README_: BEWARE: THIS IS NOT A VANILLA NODE PROJECT, LET ME COUNT THE WAYS:
version is managed by script to align with API version
package.json scripts are for development and CI use, no non-dev dependencies are allowed
Open API specification files are downloaded and NEVER EDITED
LICENSE must not be attached, as the downloaded files are not ours to license

scripts._README_: scripts above included for reference, below is the important stuff
scripts.build: swag install && apiwrap bootstrap no.spk.ios && apiwrap update
scripts.lint: redocly lint skatt-inntekt-api.yaml && redocly lint skatt-inntekt-api.json
scripts.tbv: npm run build && npm run verify
